summary: Four Leaf Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of three directors (Alvin Wang, Stephen Markscheid, Rahul Mewawalla) and its CFO (Coco Kou) effective July 7, 2026, as part of a 'comprehensive governance restructuring in connection with the company's strategic repositioning.' No disagreements were cited. Three new independent directors (Nanuk Warman, Jay Izso, Mark DiSabato) were appointed, with Warman serving as audit committee chair and Izso as compensation committee chair. This abrupt, simultaneous board and officer overhaul suggests a forced/abrupt departure event rather than routine succession, likely signaling a strategic shift.
